sources.name: Hollow head with detached eyes and hands
expectations: Interior cyan eyes remain readable and follow their hollow head.
The white hand islands remain deliberately detached; no artificial arms or bridges are required.
The source head cavity is real negative space, not an opaque facial decal.

sources.name: Two heads with distinct authored faces
sources.source: Standalone two-head extension of existing rectangle fixtures
expectations: Both distinct facial identities remain readable; two source heads are not treated as one accidental eye group.
Source gaps are exact at birth; later explicit joints may develop.

sources.name: Only unlabelled body ink with disconnected fragments
sources.source: Standalone optional-label fixture; every pixel is freeform body tissue
expectations: No facial or limb hints are supplied.
All authored fragments and the central gap are preserved at birth; no arbitrary-drawing rejection.

sources.name: Rooted hair and bright eyes on a hollow head
expectations: Gold hair remains visibly rooted to its inferred host.
The two cyan eyes remain distinguishable within the hollow face.

sources.name: Limbless body without authored facial features
expectations: No eyes or mouths are invented.
The absence of authored legs must have a suitable motion fallback.

sources.name: One authored pixel
expectations: Exact one-pixel birth and a nonempty, finite descendant.
No semantic face is inferred from a lone pixel.

sources.name: Maximum overlapping typed masks
expectations: All 15 full overlapping typed masks are accepted within source budgets.
The source deliberately has no contrasting facial artwork; visible faces cannot be demanded from this input.

sources.name: Drawn egg and generated hatchling
expectations: The complete authored egg is exact at time zero.
Cracking, hatching and subsequent infant development are distinct; offspring need not resemble shell artwork.

warning: Small fixed edge cohort. Automated feature bookkeeping is not visual feature verification. Reviews remain unreviewed until actual images are inspected. Separate from population/main proof denominators.
